This script is adapted from that provided by Brieant et al.(2023), with some additions and changes (specifically scripts "01_pull_variables" and "02_data_cleaning". Tabulated ABCD data is pulled from baseline, which also includes individuals from the same household (as this is later accounted for in subsequent analyses). In this script, ABCD data are pulled, combined to one dataset, and recoded in line with the original protocol.

```{r set_libraries, include=FALSE, tidy=TRUE}

library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
library(car)
library(psych)

rm(list = ls())

#Set path for raw data files
abcd_fld <- Sys.getenv("abcd_fld")
```

```{r}
#Read in family substance use summary scores
fhx <- glue("{abcd_fld}/mental-health/mh_p_fhx.csv") %>% read.csv() %>%
 filter(eventname == "baseline_year_1_arm_1") %>% 
  dplyr::select(src_subject_id, eventname, famhx_ss_fath_prob_alc_p,famhx_ss_moth_prob_alc_p,famhx_ss_fath_prob_dg_p,
                famhx_ss_moth_prob_dg_p)


```


```{r}
##Read in parent demographics
pdemo <- glue("{abcd_fld}/abcd-general/abcd_p_demo.csv") %>% read.csv() %>%
 filter(eventname == "baseline_year_1_arm_1") %>% 
  dplyr::select(src_subject_id,eventname,
                demo_prim,demo_prnt_marital_v2,demo_prnt_ed_v2,demo_prtnr_ed_v2,demo_comb_income_v2,
                demo_fam_exp1_v2,demo_fam_exp2_v2,demo_fam_exp3_v2,demo_fam_exp4_v2,demo_fam_exp5_v2,
                demo_fam_exp6_v2,demo_fam_exp7_v2)
```

```{r}

  filter(eventname == "baseline_year_1_arm_1") %>% 
  dplyr::select(src_subject_id, eventname, reshist_addr1_adi_wsum)
```

```{r merge all data frames}
ELAdata <- full_join(fhx, asr)%>%
  full_join(pdemo) %>%
  full_join(crpbi) %>%
  full_join(fes01)%>%
  full_join(fes02)%>%
  full_join(ptsd)%>%
  full_join(pmq)%>%
  full_join(pnscss)%>%
  full_join(ynsc)%>%
  full_join(ADI)


```

```{r}
ELAdata <- ELAdata %>% rename(subjectkey = src_subject_id)

write.csv(ELAdata, file = "Data/ELAdata_combined.csv", row.names = FALSE)

ELAdata <- read.csv("Data/ELAdata_combined.csv")

str(ELAdata)
```


```{r}
##Read in and merge demographics
demo1 <- glue("{abcd_fld}/abcd-general/abcd_y_lt.csv") %>% read.csv() %>%
  filter(eventname == "baseline_year_1_arm_1") %>%
  dplyr::select(src_subject_id, interview_age)

demo2 <- glue("{abcd_fld}/gender-identity-sexual-health/gish_p_gi.csv") %>% read.csv() %>%
  filter(eventname == "baseline_year_1_arm_1") %>%
  dplyr::select(src_subject_id, demo_sex_v2)

demo <- merge(demo1, demo2, by = "src_subject_id") %>% rename(subjectkey = src_subject_id, sex = demo_sex_v2)


ELAdata <- merge(ELAdata, demo, by = "subjectkey") 

```

```{r convert variables to numeric and recode missing values}

ELAdata <- ELAdata %>%
  mutate_at(vars(3:81), as.numeric)

#Replace 777 and 999 as na

ELAdata <- ELAdata %>%
  mutate_at(vars(3:81), ~replace(., . == 777 | . == 999, NA))

#confirm that there are no 777 999 values
has_777_or_999 <- any(ELAdata == 777 | ELAdata == 999, na.rm = TRUE)
if (has_777_or_999) {
  print("The dataframe contains values of 777 or 999.")
} else {
  print("The dataframe does not contain values of 777 or 999.")
}


str(ELAdata)
```


```{r recode primary caregiver and marital status variables}
#recode demo prim, 1=bio separation from parent, 0=lives with bio parents

ELAdata$demo_prim_biosep <- ifelse(ELAdata$demo_prim >= 3,1,0)

#recode parent marital status, coding 1 and 6 are now = 0 (no parental separation) otherwise 1 (parental separation)

ELAdata$demo_parent_sep <- ifelse(ELAdata$demo_prnt_marital_v2 == 1 |    ELAdata$demo_prnt_marital_v2 == 6, 0, 1)

#remove original variables
ELAdata <- ELAdata %>%
   dplyr::select(-demo_prim, -demo_prnt_marital_v2)


```




```{r recode education variable so that it is polytomous w/fewer categories - repeated for both NOCB and non NOCB datasets}
#NDA coding: 0 = Never attended/Kindergarten only; 1 = 1st grade; 2 = 2nd grade; 3 = 3rd grade; 4 = 4th grade; 5 = 5th grade; 6 = 6th grade; 7 = 7th grade; 8 = 8th grade; 9 = 9th grade; 10 = 10th grade; 11 = 11th grade; 12 = 12th grade; 13 = High school graduate; 14 = GED or equivalent; 15 = Some college; 16 = Associate degree: Occupational; 17 = Associate degree: Academic Program; 18 = Bachelor's degree (ex. BA); 19 = Master's degree (ex. MA); 20 = Professional School degree (ex. MD); 21 = Doctoral degree

#We are following DEAP coding: 1: < HS Diploma | 2:HS Diploma/GED | 3: some college | 4: Bachelor |5: Post Graduate Degree

ELAdata <- ELAdata %>%
  mutate(demo_prnt_ed_v2 = case_when(demo_prnt_ed_v2 == 0 ~ 1,
                          demo_prnt_ed_v2 == 1 ~ 1,
                          demo_prnt_ed_v2 == 2 ~ 1,
                          demo_prnt_ed_v2 == 3 ~ 1,
                          demo_prnt_ed_v2 == 4 ~ 1,
                          demo_prnt_ed_v2 == 5 ~ 1,
                          demo_prnt_ed_v2 == 6 ~ 1,
                          demo_prnt_ed_v2 == 7 ~ 1,
                          demo_prnt_ed_v2 == 8 ~ 1,
                          demo_prnt_ed_v2 == 9 ~ 1,
                          demo_prnt_ed_v2 == 10 ~ 1,
                          demo_prnt_ed_v2 == 11 ~ 1,
                          demo_prnt_ed_v2 == 12 ~ 1,
                          demo_prnt_ed_v2 == 13 ~ 2,
                          demo_prnt_ed_v2 == 14 ~ 2,
                          demo_prnt_ed_v2 == 15 ~ 3,
                          demo_prnt_ed_v2 == 16 ~ 3,
                          demo_prnt_ed_v2 == 17 ~ 3,
                          demo_prnt_ed_v2 == 18 ~ 4,
                          demo_prnt_ed_v2 == 19 ~ 5,
                          demo_prnt_ed_v2 == 20 ~ 5,
                          demo_prnt_ed_v2 == 21 ~ 5,
                          TRUE ~ NA_real_))
ELAdata <- ELAdata %>%
   mutate(demo_prtnr_ed_v2 = case_when(demo_prtnr_ed_v2 == 0 ~ 1,
                          demo_prtnr_ed_v2 == 1 ~ 1,
                          demo_prtnr_ed_v2 == 2 ~ 1,
                          demo_prtnr_ed_v2 == 3 ~ 1,
                          demo_prtnr_ed_v2 == 4 ~ 1,
                          demo_prtnr_ed_v2 == 5 ~ 1,
                          demo_prtnr_ed_v2 == 6 ~ 1,
                          demo_prtnr_ed_v2 == 7 ~ 1,
                          demo_prtnr_ed_v2 == 8 ~ 1,
                          demo_prtnr_ed_v2 == 9 ~ 1,
                          demo_prtnr_ed_v2 == 10 ~ 1,
                          demo_prtnr_ed_v2 == 11 ~ 1,
                          demo_prtnr_ed_v2 == 12 ~ 1,
                          demo_prtnr_ed_v2 == 13 ~ 2,
                          demo_prtnr_ed_v2 == 14 ~ 2,
                          demo_prtnr_ed_v2 == 15 ~ 3,
                          demo_prtnr_ed_v2 == 16 ~ 3,
                          demo_prtnr_ed_v2 == 17 ~ 3,
                          demo_prtnr_ed_v2 == 18 ~ 4,
                          demo_prtnr_ed_v2 == 19 ~ 5,
                          demo_prtnr_ed_v2 == 20 ~ 5,
                          demo_prtnr_ed_v2 == 21 ~ 5,
                          TRUE ~ NA_real_))

#take max value between caregivers
ELAdata$demo_prnt_ed_v2 <- pmax(ELAdata$demo_prnt_ed_v2, ELAdata$demo_prtnr_ed_v2,
                                      na.rm = TRUE)

#remove partner ed variable, no longer needed
ELAdata <- ELAdata %>% 
  dplyr::select(-demo_prtnr_ed_v2)


write.csv(ELAdata, file = "Data/ELAdata_combined.csv", row.names = FALSE)

ELAdata <- read.csv("Data/ELAdata_combined.csv")


```


```{r reverse code variables}
##recoding variables so that higher values reflect greater adversity for all variables



##crpbi variables
ELAdata$crpbi_parent1_y = recode(ELAdata$crpbi_parent1_y, "1=3; 2=2; 3=1")
ELAdata$crpbi_parent2_y = recode(ELAdata$crpbi_parent2_y, "1=3; 2=2; 3=1")
ELAdata$crpbi_parent3_y = recode(ELAdata$crpbi_parent3_y, "1=3; 2=2; 3=1")
ELAdata$crpbi_parent4_y = recode(ELAdata$crpbi_parent4_y, "1=3; 2=2; 3=1")
ELAdata$crpbi_parent5_y = recode(ELAdata$crpbi_parent5_y, "1=3; 2=2; 3=1")

ELAdata$crpbi_caregiver12_y = recode(ELAdata$crpbi_caregiver12_y, "1=3; 2=2; 3=1")
ELAdata$crpbi_caregiver13_y = recode(ELAdata$crpbi_caregiver13_y, "1=3; 2=2; 3=1")
ELAdata$crpbi_caregiver14_y = recode(ELAdata$crpbi_caregiver14_y, "1=3; 2=2; 3=1")
ELAdata$crpbi_caregiver15_y = recode(ELAdata$crpbi_caregiver15_y, "1=3; 2=2; 3=1")
ELAdata$crpbi_caregiver16_y = recode(ELAdata$crpbi_caregiver16_y, "1=3; 2=2; 3=1")

####income and education variables

#demo_comb_income_v2 ranges from 1 to 10, 1 is lowest income category and 10 is highest
ELAdata$demo_comb_income_v2 = recode(ELAdata$demo_comb_income_v2, "1=10; 2=9; 3=8; 4=7; 5=6; 6=5; 7=4; 8=3; 9=2; 10=1")

#reverse code polytomous version of parent education variable
ELAdata$demo_prnt_ed_v2 = recode(ELAdata$demo_prnt_ed_v2, "1=5; 2=4; 3=3; 4=2; 5=1")

##parental monitoring variables, original coding is 1 = Never; 2 = Almost Never; 3 = Sometimes; 4 = Often; 5 = Always or Almost Always (higher values = less adversity)

ELAdata$parent_monitor_q1_y = recode(ELAdata$parent_monitor_q1_y, "1=5; 2=4; 3=3; 4=2; 5=1")
ELAdata$parent_monitor_q2_y = recode(ELAdata$parent_monitor_q2_y, "1=5; 2=4; 3=3; 4=2; 5=1")
ELAdata$parent_monitor_q3_y = recode(ELAdata$parent_monitor_q3_y, "1=5; 2=4; 3=3; 4=2; 5=1")
ELAdata$parent_monitor_q4_y = recode(ELAdata$parent_monitor_q4_y, "1=5; 2=4; 3=3; 4=2; 5=1")
ELAdata$parent_monitor_q5_y = recode(ELAdata$parent_monitor_q5_y, "1=5; 2=4; 3=3; 4=2; 5=1")

####neighborhood variables

#neighborhood_crime_y ranges 1-5
ELAdata$neighborhood_crime_y = recode(ELAdata$neighborhood_crime_y, "1=5; 2=4; 3=3; 4=2; 5=1")

#nsc_p_ss_mean_3_items is continuous, multiply by -1 to reverse code
ELAdata$nsc_p_ss_mean_3_items = (ELAdata$nsc_p_ss_mean_3_items) * -1


write.csv(ELAdata, file = "Data/ELAdata_for_MICE.csv", row.names = FALSE)  
ELAdata_clean <- read.csv("Data/ELAdata_for_MICE.csv")

str(ELAdata_clean)

```




```{r check degree of missing data across variables}

ELA_var_sums_NA <- as.data.frame(sapply(ELAdata_clean, function(x) sum(is.na(x))))
ELA_var_sums_NA

write.csv(ELA_var_sums_NA, file = "Data/ELAdata_clean_missingdata.csv", row.names = TRUE)

ELAdat_nona <- na.omit(ELAdata_clean)
# 8550 observations with complete data

```
